Star Fox Enhanced adapts a subset of these interface declarations to a C++
namespace with renamed members and default initialization. Structure layouts
and provisional numeric identifiers are retained. No proprietary SR SDK code,
SR Platform, runtime binary or vendor weaver is included in this adaptation.
